source_instruction: i am looking for tulua apple cider vinegar lemon ginger flavored fruit juice that is certified organic.
query: Ugh, I swear the parking lot at this shopping center is designed specifically to test every last bit of my patience today. I circled for a full 12 minutes before I finally snagged a spot way out by the garden center entrance, and then some guy in a giant lifted truck almost took my passenger side mirror off when he whipped around the lane without even using his turn signal. The second I stepped through the doors I got hit with that overwhelming smell of the fresh-baked cinnamon rolls from the bakery by the front, which would’ve been nice if I hadn’t skipped breakfast to run these errands and my stomach wasn’t already growling so loud the person grabbing a cart next to me glanced over like they thought there was a stray cat yowling somewhere nearby. Hey, I’m browsing the beverages section right now looking for that one I always pick up from Tulua, can you help me find it? I need it to be fair trade certified, and my budget cap is $60 total, I don’t want to go over that at all. Oh, and make sure the bottle comes with a reusable pour spout attached, that’s non-negotiable for me this trip. I don’t have time to scroll through all the options myself so if you can pull up the right matches fast that’d be great.
